text_block_list.text:
On my way to the track, I am<n>intercepted by a
visibly chipper Taiki<n>Shuttle.

Get a load of this, Trainer! I just got<n>invited to go
partner runnin' again!
Yeah, your fault! The gal who askedsaid she could learn a lot from me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She was keen on finding out how I<n>spiced up my
runnin' so much!

So I told her it was your fault for<n>expanding my
horizons!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You taught me about a world where<n>speed alone
won't score ya wins.<n>Now I get flutters thinkin'
about how<n>to overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to cool off since<n>the day we
met, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm always burnin' up with passion...

You better take responsibility for<n>lettin' me in on
something so exciting!

We're gonna forge this future of ours<n>together!
Back out now, and I'm<n>huntin' ya down! Bang!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate the thought, I<n>should probably do
something about<n>her choice of language before
someone gets the wrong idea.
